description: FreeCAD is open with a new empty document and the Part workbench active. Create a Box primitive with the following exact dimensions: Length=60 mm, Width=40 mm, Height=25 mm. You can create the Box via the menu Part > Primitives > Create a primitive... (select Box) or via Part > Box. After creating the box, make sure the dimensions are set correctly in the properties panel on the left. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/box_model.FCStd' using File > Save As.
